Frequently Asked Question
Which B.Tech branches are available at JIIT?
JIIT offers B.Tech across core and emerging areas, including Computer Science, IT, Electronics, Biotechnology, AI & ML, Cyber Security, Robotics & AI, Mathematics & Computing, VLSI Design, and Advanced Communication Technology.
What are the eligibility criteria for B.Tech admission at JIIT?
Candidates must have passed 10+2 (or equivalent) in 2024, 2025, or 2026, from a recognised board with Physics and Mathematics and one additional subject from the approved list, securing minimum 60% aggregate marks (55% for SC/ST) and a pass grade in all subjects. Admission is based on 10+2 merit (Physics, Mathematics, and one approved subject) or JEE Main AIR 2026.
Which companies recruit from JIIT for B.Tech placements?
Recruiters include companies such as Microsoft, Amazon, Google, Adobe, Morgan Stanley, SAP Labs, Intuit, and Deloitte, among others.
What is the mode of admission for B.Tech programmes?
Admissions are offered through 10+2 merit and JEE Main AIR 2026. Merit-based admissions consider marks scored in Class 10th/12th and Diploma/UG degree final examinations. Direct admissions are also available for ECM, Integrated ECE, VLSI, and ACT programmes.
What specialised labs and facilities are available to B.Tech students?
Students work in 125+ laboratories, supported by centres such as the Ramanujan High-Performance Computing Facility and the RIDE Innovation Hub. The campus also includes the 5G Use Case Lab and programme-specific labs across AI, robotics, VLSI, and Cybersecurity.
Are hostel facilities available for B.Tech students at JIIT?
Yes. JIIT offers limited on-campus hostel facilities with separate accommodation for boys and girls, along with dining services, internet connectivity, and campus support infrastructure. Accommodation is typically provided on a shared basis (2-person sharing to 6-person sharing), as per merit of 10+2.
